name: New Mexico

ttd.rateText: Two-thirds of the worker's average weekly wage, based on wages for the 26 weeks before the accident (WCA, Indemnity Benefits); maximum is 100% of the state average weekly wage (WCA disability rates table; NMSA 1978, § 52-1-41).
ttd.minText: Weekly minimum listed in the WCA disability rates table for 1/2026.

waiting.text: TTD starts on the 8th day of non-work status (days need not be consecutive); the first 7 days are paid only if the worker is off work more than 4 weeks (WCA FAQs; NMSA 1978, § 52-1-40).

ttdDuration.text: TTD stops at maximum medical improvement or when the worker is offered or accepts work at the pre-injury wage (WCA FAQs). Combined TTD and PPD for a whole-body injury are limited to 500 weeks when the PPD rating is under 80%, and 700 weeks at 80% or more (WCA, Indemnity Benefits).

ppd.text: Whole-body PPD is the compensation rate times the impairment rating if the worker returns at the pre-injury wage; otherwise modifiers for age, education, skill level (SVP) and residual physical capacity are added to the impairment rating (WCA, Indemnity Benefits; NMSA 1978, § 52-1-26). Scheduled injuries to specific body parts are paid by statutory schedule (§ 52-1-43).

facts.text: The 2026 maximum equals 100% of the state average weekly wage of $1,146.66; the maximum total for 500 weeks is $573,275 and for 700 weeks $802,585 (WCA disability rates table dated July 22, 2025).
Employers with three or more employees must carry workers' compensation insurance; owning executives of corporations and LLCs count toward the three (WCA FAQs, NMSA 1978, § 52-1-7).
Whoever did not pick the first doctor (worker or employer) has an automatic right to change doctors after 60 days of treatment (WCA FAQs).
The employer must report the accident to its insurer within 72 hours after the worker reports it (WCA FAQs).
Workers' attorney fees are charged only if the attorney obtains a benefit (NMSA 1978, § 52-1-54, WCA FAQs); the WCA reports that 75% of disputes resolve at mediation.

uncertain: NMSA section numbers 52-1-40, 52-1-41, 52-1-42, 52-1-26 and 52-1-43 were not read in the statute text itself (only 52-1-7, 52-1-41(F) reference and 52-1-54 are cited on WCA pages); the rules themselves come from WCA pages.
The WCA table lists a flat $36.00 weekly minimum; whether actual wages below that are paid in full was not stated on the pages read.
